description: This Java source file defines a class named CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor, which is a visitor implementation used to traverse a permission policy tree. Its purpose is to collect subject IDs that have certain permissions granted on a resource or its sub-resources, considering only granted permissions and ignoring revocations. The class is marked as deprecated in favor of a newer visitor class. It contains inner classes, methods for evaluating permissions, and logic specific to the project's permission model.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for traversing permission policy trees to collect subject IDs with specific granted permissions. It maintains internal state to evaluate permissions per subject and resource node, and provides a method to retrieve the set of subject IDs that meet the criteria.

classes.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor.ResourceNodeEvaluator
classes.description: Inner class responsible for evaluating permissions of a specific subject ID across resource nodes, and determining if that subject should be included based on granted permissions matching expected permissions.

methods.name: CollectPartialGrantedSubjectIdsVisitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the visitor with a resource pointer and expected permissions.

methods.name: visitTreeNode
methods.description: Handles the traversal of a tree node, delegating to specific handlers based on node type.

methods.name: visitSubjectNode
methods.description: Handles processing when a subject node is encountered, initializing an evaluator for that subject.

methods.name: visitResourceNode
methods.description: Processes resource nodes by aggregating permissions for the current subject evaluator.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Finalizes evaluation by processing all resource evaluators and returning the set of subject IDs granted the expected permissions.
